title: Super Bowl XXXIII
overview: Super Bowl XXXIII, played on January 31, 1999, at Pro Player Stadium in Miami, saw the Denver Broncos defeat the Atlanta Falcons 34-19, securing back-to-back championships and sending John Elway into retirement as a two-time Super Bowl champion. The victory capped off Elway’s legendary career, as he earned Super Bowl MVP honors in what would be his final game.
